title: Billing
purpose: Show usage against limits as readings and change plan with the cost reviewed before it's confirmed.
useWhen: A product shows what someone pays for, how much they've used, and lets them change plan.
avoidWhen: A one-off checkout for a single purchase; use the review-submit contract with the payment provider's checkout.
alternatives: Use the review-submit contract for a one-off purchase, and the settings contract for billing contact details.
requiredInputs: usage per quota with limits and thresholds
an estimate and how it's computed
a proration preview from the billing service
transitions: ready → choosing → reviewing with the proration
reviewing → changing on confirm, or choosing to pick again
changing → changed when the service confirms, or change-failed with nothing charged
choosing → downgrade-review when the plan removes access
ready → payment-failed when a charge fails, until the payment method is updated
applicability: Products with plans, usage limits, plan changes and invoices.
exceptions: Require only states supported by the application; flat-priced products without usage skip the quota states.
